sources.title: Waste
sources.facts: Explains waste planning, need, site selection and interaction with environmental permitting.
sources.guard: Planning guidance does not prove a waste facility is permitted or operational.

sources.title: National planning policy for waste
sources.facts: Sets policy tests for waste plans and development management.
sources.guard: Policy is not a site allocation, permit or construction approval.

sources.title: Guidance on applying the waste hierarchy
sources.facts: Ranks prevention, reuse, recycling, recovery and disposal by environmental preference.
sources.guard: Hierarchy position does not prove a particular treatment route is lawful or available.

sources.title: Waste: environmental permits
sources.facts: Explains when waste use, recycling, treatment, storage or disposal may require a permit.
sources.guard: Permit guidance does not prove an application or current permit status.

sources.title: Simpler recycling: household recycling in England
sources.facts: Sets household collection requirements applying from 31 March 2026, subject to transitions.
sources.guard: Collection rules do not prove local infrastructure capacity or compliance.

sources.title: Simpler recycling: workplace recycling in England
sources.facts: Explains separation duties for businesses and relevant non-domestic premises.
sources.guard: General duties do not prove a specific producer or collector complies.

sources.title: Digital waste tracking service
sources.facts: Sets staged reporting requirements, including permitted receiving sites from October 2026.
sources.guard: A future reporting duty does not prove data completeness, legality or waste destination.

sources.title: Waste recovery plans and deposit for recovery permits
sources.facts: Explains recovery plans and permit requirements for deposit-for-recovery operations.
sources.guard: Guidance does not prove recovery purpose, permit grant or environmental acceptability.
